candidates.change_summary: Replace the overflow-checking require with one that always fails when depositsCount is nonzero, preventing increment for any nonzero count.
Replace the require condition so it always reverts (false), making the receive revert on every call.
Remove the require check so depositsCount is always incremented without protection.
Change increment to decrement so receive decreases depositsCount instead of increasing it.
Insert an extra increment, causing depositsCount to increase by 2 on each receive call.
Replace the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with a direct transfer of the contract balance to msg.sender.
Replace the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with a call to withdraw(0) so no funds are sent.
Replace the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with a call to sendMoney forwarding the full balance using low-level call (which does not revert on failure).
Change the onlyOwner modifier's require to check owner != msg.sender, inverting the ownership check (so only non-owners can call guarded functions).
